text_en: My friends, if anyone is detected in a transgression, you who have received the Spirit should restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness. Take care that you yourselves are not tempted.
text_cn: 弟兄们，如果见一个人陷于某种过犯，你们既是属神的人，就该以柔和的心神矫正他；但你们自己要小心，免得也陷入诱惑。

text_en: Bear one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
text_cn: 你们应彼此协助背负重担，这样，你们就满全了基督的法律。

text_en: For if those who are nothing think they are something, they deceive themselves.
text_cn: 人本来不算什么，若自以为算什么，就是欺骗自己。

text_en: All must test their own work; then that work, rather than their neighbor’s work, will become a cause for pride.
text_cn: 各人只该考验自己的行为，这样，对自己也许有可夸耀之处，但不是对别人夸耀，

text_en: For all must carry their own loads.
text_cn: 因为各人要背负自己的重担。

text_en: Those who are taught the word must share in all good things with their teacher.
text_cn: 学习真道的，应让教师分享自己的一切财物。

text_en: Do not be deceived; God is not mocked, for you reap whatever you sow.
text_cn: 你们切不要错了，天主是嘲笑不得的：人种什么，就收什么。

text_en: If you sow to your own flesh, you will reap corruption from the flesh; but if you sow to the Spirit, you will reap eternal life from the Spirit.
text_cn: 那随从肉情撒种的，必由肉情收获败坏；然而那随从圣神撒种的，必由圣神收获永生。

text_en: So let us not grow weary in doing what is right, for we will reap at harvest time, if we do not give up.
text_cn: 为此，我们行善不要厌倦；如果不松懈，到了适当的时节，必可收获。

text_en: So then, whenever we have an opportunity, let us work for the good of all, and especially for those of the family of faith.
text_cn: 所以，我们一有机会，就应向众人行善，尤其应向有同样信德的家人。

text_en: See what large letters I make when I am writing in my own hand!
text_cn: 你们看，我亲手给你们写的是多么大的字！

text_en: It is those who want to make a good showing in the flesh that try to compel you to be circumcised—only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
text_cn: 那些逼迫你们受割损的人，是想以外表的礼节来图人称赞，免得因基督的十字架遭受迫害；

text_en: Even the circumcised do not themselves obey the law, but they want you to be circumcised so that they may boast about your flesh.
text_cn: 其实，他们虽然受了割损，却也不遵守法律；他们只是愿意你们受割损，为能因在你们的肉身上所行的礼仪而夸耀。

text_en: May I never boast of anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
text_cn: 至于我，我只以我们的主耶稣基督的十字架来夸耀，因为藉着基督，世界于我已被钉在十字架上了；我于世界也被钉在十字架上了。

text_en: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision is anything; but a new creation is everything!
text_cn: 其实，割损或不割损都算不得什么，要紧的是新受造的人。

text_en: As for those who will follow this rule—peace be upon them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
text_cn: 凡以此为规律而行的，愿平安与怜悯降在他们身上，即降在天主的新以色列身上！

text_en: From now on, let no one make trouble for me; for I carry the marks of Jesus branded on my body.
text_cn: 从今以后，我切愿没有人再烦扰我，因为在我身上，我带有耶稣的烙印。

text_en: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers and sisters. Amen.
text_cn: 弟兄们！愿我们的主耶稣基督的恩宠，常与你们的心灵同在！阿们。
